title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 stored XSS in the Shared Resources build feature was possible…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in JetBrains TeamCity versions before 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7 in the Shared Resources build feature. This vulnerability allows an attacker with high privileges and user interaction to inject malicious scripts that can affect the confidentiality and integrity of the system. The vulnerability has a medium severity score of 4.8 and does not impact availability.
